</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000499" name="BFRG:CostOfRevenuePolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_84D_ecustom--CostOfRevenuePolicyTextBlock_zQn4Ayt0Rf1e" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i><span id="xdx_86A_zlWEH5JbDwGb">Cost
of Revenue</span></i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Cost
of revenue consists primarily of the allocation of personnel costs (e.g. payroll, benefits, and consulting fees) of our employees and
third-party consultants directly attributable to the satisfaction of our performance obligations under our revenue arrangements.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000501" name="us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentPolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_84A_eus-gaap--PropertyPlantAndEquipmentPolicyTextBlock_zAL6tXqGt9Q" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i><span id="xdx_869_z3rkd14SEaAe">Property
and Equipment, net</span></i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt; background-color: white">Property
and equipment are stated at cost. When retired or otherwise disposed, the related carrying value and accumulated depreciation are removed
from the respective accounts and the net difference less any amount realized from disposition is reflected in earnings. For financial
statement purposes, property and equipment are recorded at cost and depreciated using the straight-line method over their estimated useful
lives.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000503" name="us-gaap:AdvertisingCostsPolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_845_eus-gaap--AdvertisingCostsPolicyTextBlock_zRh1mPlnHtn5" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i><span id="xdx_862_zq2CmvmABVT9">Advertising</span></i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt; background-color: white">The
Company follows the policy of charging the costs of advertising to expense as incurred.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000505" name="us-gaap:IncomeTaxPolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_84E_eus-gaap--IncomeTaxPolicyTextBlock_zsSQv048Nvkb" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i><span id="xdx_860_zyQwva90WuFe">Income
Taxes</span></i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Deferred
income tax assets and liabilities are determined based on the estimated future tax effects of net operating losses, credit carryforwards,
and temporary differences between the tax basis of assets and liabilities and their respective financial reporting amounts measured at
the current enacted tax rates. The Company records an estimated valuation allowance on its deferred income tax assets if it is not more
likely than not that these deferred income tax assets will be realized.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company recognizes a tax benefit from an uncertain tax position if it is more likely than not that the tax position will be sustained
on examination by taxing authorities. Interest and penalties associated with such uncertain tax positions are classified as a component
of income tax expense.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000507" name="us-gaap:CompensationRelatedCostsPolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_843_eus-gaap--CompensationRelatedCostsPolicyTextBlock_zLH9EhK2n3If" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i><span id="xdx_86B_zpOYxYZ97afg">Stock-Based
Compensation</span></i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Employee
and non-employee share-based compensation is measured at the grant date, based on the fair value of the award, and is recognized as an
expense over the requisite service period. Forfeitures are recognized as they occur.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000509" name="us-gaap:EarningsPerSharePolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_84F_eus-gaap--EarningsPerSharePolicyTextBlock_zWyiFWQyYBWe" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i><span id="xdx_866_zaCrmO68heZf">Net
Loss per Share</span></i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company calculates basic net loss per common share by dividing the net loss available to common stockholders by the weighted-average
number of shares of common stock outstanding during the period.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Diluted
earnings per share is computed by giving effect to all potentially dilutive common stock equivalents in the period, including unvested
stock options and warrants. As the Company has reported losses for all periods presented, all potentially dilutive securities have been
excluded from the calculation of diluted net loss per common share as their effect would be antidilutive.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000511" name="us-gaap:NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_84C_eus-gaap--NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyTextBlock_zRXdgJ9HeJgg" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i><span id="xdx_861_zAylV3XCvfMh">Recent
Accounting Pronouncements</span></i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
January 2024, the Company adopted Accounting Standards Update (ASU) 2023-07, <i>Improvements to Reportable Segment Disclosures (Topic
280). </i>The new standard improves reportable segment disclosure requirements, primarily through enhanced disclosures about significant
segment expenses that are regularly provided to the chief operating decision maker. ASU 2023-07 also clarifies that entities with a single
reportable segment are subject to both new and existing reporting requirements under Topic 280. The adoption of this guidance did not
result in a material effect on the Company&#8217;s financial statements. See the <i>Segment Reporting </i>section within Note 2<i>.</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></p>

    <div style="border-bottom: Black 1pt solid; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-right: 0pt"><table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><tr style="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><td style="text-align: center; width: 100%">F-<!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->11<!-- Field: /Sequence --></td></tr></table></div>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
December 2023, the FASB issued ASU No. 2023-09: Income Taxes (Topic 740): <i>Improvements to Income Tax Disclosures</i> that requires
entities to disclose additional information about federal, state, and foreign income taxes primarily related to the income tax rate reconciliation
and income taxes paid. The new standard also eliminates certain existing disclosure requirements related to uncertain tax positions and
unrecognized deferred tax liabilities. The guidance is effective for the Company&#8217;s fiscal year ending December 31, 2025. The guidance
does not affect recognition or measurement in the Company&#8217;s consolidated financial statements. For comparative purposes, the Company
elected to present its 2024 income tax disclosures in this new manner, but the adoption of this guidance did not result in a material
effect on the Company&#8217;s financial statements. See Note 9, Income Taxes.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
July 2025, the FASB issued ASU No. 2025-05 which amends Topic 326. Specifically, the ASU provides a practical expedient whereby an entity
can assume that current conditions as of the balance sheet date will not change for the remaining life of the asset (e.g., the accounts
receivable). This guidance is effective for the Company&#8217;s fiscal year ending December 31, 2026 and can be adopted early. The Company
is in the process of evaluating the effects of this guidance on its consolidated financial statements.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
September 2025, the FASB issued ASU No. 2025-07 which, among other things, provides scope clarification for share-based noncash consideration
from a customer in a revenue contract. Specifically, the ASU clarifies that share-based payments from customers in exchange for the transfer
of goods or services should be accounted for as noncash consideration within the scope of ASC 606 as opposed to as a derivative pursuant
to ASC 815 or as an equity security pursuant to ASC 321. This guidance is effective for the Company&#8217;s fiscal year ending December
31, 2027 and can be adopted early. The Company is in the process of evaluating the effects of this guidance on its consolidated financial
statements.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company does not believe that any other recently issued effective pronouncements, or pronouncements issued but not yet effective, if
adopted, would have a material effect on the accompanying financial statements.</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><p id="xdx_85D_zg8mkVPep8S4" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000513" name="us-gaap:InvestmentTextBlock"><p id="xdx_80A_eus-gaap--InvestmentTextBlock_z7DNU0hqq76e" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-right: 0pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>3.</b></span> <span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><span id="xdx_82A_zbDu3kcUcoie">Investments</span></b></span></p>



<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company&#8217;s sole investment is in the form of equity securities in a private entity. The Company entered into a strategic collaboration
agreement and received such equity securities as remuneration for services rendered. The investment is initially valued at approximately
$<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--LongTermInvestments_iI_c20251231_zKqyTUCsnVJl" title="Long term investments"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:LongTermInvestments" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact000515" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">117,000</ix:nonFraction></span> (see Note 6). The Company has elected the measurement alternative and, accordingly, the investment is carried at its estimated
fair value calculated as its cost less any impairment charges until such time as there is evidence of an orderly transaction (see Note
2). As of December 31, 2025, no fair value adjustments have been recognized, nor have there been any impairment charges. This investment
is considered a financial asset that is measured at fair value on a non-recurring basis.</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000553" name="us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerTextBlock"><p id="xdx_807_eus-gaap--RevenueFromContractWithCustomerTextBlock_zDG87lPMR5i5" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-right: 0pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>6.</b></span> <span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><span id="xdx_829_zIQryzyTQYqg">Revenue</span></b></span></p>



<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">During
2025, the Company had a collaboration agreement with a single customer, Eleison Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (&#8220;Eleison&#8221;), for
contract services. The collaboration agreement, which was entered into in February 2025 and designed to enhance clinical trial
efficacy, extract actionable insights from historical and ongoing data and improve strategic planning for Eleison&#8217;s oncology
pipeline, was deemed to have multiple deliverables with revenue to be recognized at the time each deliverable was completed. In
exchange for the services provided, the Company was entitled to consideration in the form of cash or equity securities of the
customer or any combination at the customer&#8217;s sole discretion. The Company received the initial payment in the second quarter
of 2025, representing 50% of the total consideration, in the form of equity securities of the customer valued at approximately
$<span id="xdx_90D_ecustom--ProceedsFromEquitySecuritiesReceived_c20250101__20250630_z9y1yIk3y9fk" title="Value of equity securities received from customer"><ix:nonFraction name="BFRG:ProceedsFromEquitySecuritiesReceived" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-06-30" id="Fact000555" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">58,000</ix:nonFraction></span>.
The remaining consideration, also valued at approximately $<span id="xdx_901_ecustom--ProceedsFromEquitySecuritiesRemainingConsiderationReceived_c20250101__20250930_zGoqk1oKyEz9" title="Value of equity securities received from customer"><ix:nonFraction name="BFRG:ProceedsFromEquitySecuritiesRemainingConsiderationReceived" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-09-30" id="Fact000557" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">58,000</ix:nonFraction></span>,
was received in the form of equity securities of the customer following completion of the final deliverable in the third quarter of
2025. The Company allocated the total proceeds to each of the separate deliverables on a relative basis based on the estimated
stand-alone selling price of each deliverable. All deliverables were completed in the year ended December 31, 2025 and,
consequently, the Company recognized approximately $<span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--ContractWithCustomerLiabilityRevenueRecognized_c20250101__20251231_z7BC8tnlP9s5" title="Revenue recognized"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerLiabilityRevenueRecognized" contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" id="Fact000559" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">117,000</ix:nonFraction></span>
of revenue at the point in time that each deliverable was completed (see Note 3).</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
June 2025, the Company entered into a strategic collaboration with Sygnature Discovery (&#8220;Sygnature&#8221;), a UK-based contract
research organization specializing in drug discovery. Under this collaboration, Sygnature will introduce BullFrog Data Networks&#8482;,
the Company&#8217;s proprietary AI-driven data insights platform powered by the bfLEAP&#8482; engine, to Sygnature&#8217;s global biopharma
client base. Any commercial terms for the marketing collaboration will be agreed by the parties in a subsequent agreement. The Company
has not yet recognized any revenue under this collaboration.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>2022
Equity Incentive Plan</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt; background-color: white">In
November 2022, the Company&#8217;s Board of Directors adopted, and its shareholders approved, the 2022 Equity Incentive Plan (the &#8220;Plan&#8221;).
The Plan provides for the granting of equity-based awards to employees, directors, and consultants. The Plan provides for equity-based
awards including incentive stock options, non-qualified stock options, stock appreciation rights, performance share awards, cash awards
and other equity-based awards. Awards are limited to a maximum term of <span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingPeriod1_dtY_c20221101__20221130__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--TwoThousandTwentyTwoEquityIncentivePlanMember_zY7T0gI3AeU" title="Original life"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2022-11-012022-11-30_custom_TwoThousandTwentyTwoEquityIncentivePlanMember" format="ixt-sec:duryear" id="Fact000685" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingPeriod1">10</ix:nonNumeric></span> years and any exercise prices shall not be less than 100% of
the fair market value of one share of common stock on the grant date. The Plan authorized an initial maximum number of shares underlying
awards of <span id="xdx_907_ecustom--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAuthorizedUnderEquityPlan_iI_c20221130__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--TwentyTwentyTwoEquityIncentivePlanMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_zJUqfFdxPs53" title="Initial maximum number of shares authorized under equity incentive plan"><ix:nonFraction name="BFRG:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAuthorizedUnderEquityPlan" contextRef="AsOf2022-11-30_custom_TwentyTwentyTwoEquityIncentivePlanMember_srt_MaximumMember" id="Fact000687" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">900,000</ix:nonFraction></span> with an automatic annual increase to an amount equal to <span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardPercentageOfOutstandingStockMaximum_pid_dp_c20221101__20221130__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--TwentyTwentyTwoEquityIncentivePlanMember_zRaMxQaBMMw5" title="Increase in shares under equity plan per year, percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardPercentageOfOutstandingStockMaximum" contextRef="From2022-11-012022-11-30_custom_TwentyTwentyTwoEquityIncentivePlanMember" id="Fact000689" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">15</ix:nonFraction></span>% of the total number of shares outstanding as of the end
of the preceding fiscal year. In October 2025, the Company&#8217;s stockholders approved an amendment to the Plan to increase the number
of shares available for issuance under the Plan by <span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAuthorized_iI_c20251031__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--TwentyTwentyTwoEquityIncentivePlanMember_zhHFlqBRg6Jf" title="Awards authorized but unissued"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAuthorized" contextRef="AsOf2025-10-31_custom_TwentyTwentyTwoEquityIncentivePlanMember" id="Fact000691" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">750,000</ix:nonFraction></span>. As of December 31, 2025, there are <span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAuthorized_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--TwentyTwentyTwoEquityIncentivePlanMember_zUN3kbtylzg1" title="Awards authorized but unissued"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAuthorized" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_TwentyTwentyTwoEquityIncentivePlanMember" id="Fact000693" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">891,975</ix:nonFraction></span> awards authorized but unissued
available under the Plan.</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><p id="xdx_8AC_z7PlKq9IT5c7" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: center"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Realization
of the Company&#8217;s deferred tax assets is dependent upon future earnings, if any, the timing, and amount of which are uncertain.
Because of the Company&#8217;s lack of U.S. earnings history, the net U.S. deferred tax assets have been fully offset by a valuation
allowance. The valuation allowance increased by $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--ValuationAllowanceDeferredTaxAssetChangeInAmount_c20250101__20251231_z6v2SqdYPXUj" title="Annual increase in valuation allowance"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ValuationAllowanceDeferredTaxAssetChangeInAmount" contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" id="Fact001038" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">1,826,986</ix:nonFraction></span> and $<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--ValuationAllowanceDeferredTaxAssetChangeInAmount_c20240101__20241231_zOYxNW1tIhM3" title="Annual increase in valuation allowance"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ValuationAllowanceDeferredTaxAssetChangeInAmount" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-12-31" id="Fact001040" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">1,583,168</ix:nonFraction></span> during the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
of December 31, 2025, the Company has available for federal income tax purposes a gross net operating loss carryforward of approximately
$<span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwardsDomestic_iI_pn5n6_c20251231_zOf8gGKXluHi" title="Operating loss carryforwards federal"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwardsDomestic" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact001042" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">16.9</ix:nonFraction></span> million and a gross state net operating loss carryforward of approximately $<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwardsStateAndLocal_iI_pn5n6_c20251231_ztNxqivtEBul" title="Operating loss carryforwards state"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwardsStateAndLocal" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact001044" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">8.5</ix:nonFraction></span> million. The federal net operating loss carryforward
does not expire and may be used to offset future taxable income. The state gross net operating loss begins to expire in 2043. Utilization
of some of the federal and state net operating loss carryforwards is subject to annual limitations due to the &#8220;change in ownership&#8221;
provisions of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 and similar state provisions. The annual limitations may result in the expiration of
net operating losses and credits before utilization.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company has provided a valuation allowance against the full amount of the net operating loss benefit and its other net deferred tax assets
since, in the opinion of management, based upon the earnings history of the Company, it is more likely than not that the future tax benefits
of the Company&#8217;s net deferred tax assets will not be realized. All or a portion of the remaining valuation allowance may be reduced
in future years based on an assessment of earnings sufficient to fully utilize these potential tax benefits.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
required under ASU 2023-09, the Company has included only the portion of the valuation allowance related to federal deferred tax assets
in the &#8220;change in valuation allowance&#8221; line of the rate reconciliation. The following table presents a reconciliation of
the total change in the valuation allowance:</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><p id="xdx_8A3_z2PK12jbZsrh" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: center"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company has incurred net operating losses since inception and it did not have unrecognized tax benefits as of December 31, 2025 and 2024,
and does not anticipate this to change significantly over the next 12 months. The Company will recognize interest and penalties accrued
on any unrecognized tax benefits as a component of income tax expense.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company files income tax returns in the U.S. and certain state jurisdictions. The Company is not currently under examination in these
jurisdictions for any tax year. The Company&#8217;s tax years beginning with 2022 are open tax years. Because of net operating losses
and research credit carryovers, substantially all the Company&#8217;s tax years remain open to examination.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact001094" name="BFRG:LicenseAndRoyaltyAgreementDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_800_ecustom--LicenseAndRoyaltyAgreementDisclosureTextBlock_zsRj3hh7njSg" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-right: 0pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>10.</b></span> <span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><span id="xdx_82D_zNSRFbS9zzAi">Material Agreements</span></b></span></p>



<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i><span style="text-decoration: underline">JHU-APL
Technology License</span></i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
February 2018, the Company entered into an exclusive, world-wide, royalty-bearing license with JHU-APL (the &#8220;2018 License Agreement&#8221;).
The license covers three (3) issued patents, one (1) new provisional patent application, non-patent rights to proprietary libraries of
algorithms and other trade secrets, as well as modifications and improvements. In October 2021, the Company executed an amendment to
the original license for improvements and new advanced analytics capabilities. In consideration of the rights granted to the Company
under the 2018 License Agreement, JHU-APL received a warrant equal to five percent (<span id="xdx_905_ecustom--PercentageOfWarrantIssued_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20211031__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--JHUAPLTechnologyLicenseAgreementMember_zZtXncwekL29" title="Warrant issuance percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="BFRG:PercentageOfWarrantIssued" contextRef="AsOf2021-10-31_custom_JHUAPLTechnologyLicenseAgreementMember" id="Fact001096" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">5</ix:nonFraction></span>%) of the then fully diluted equity base of the
Company, which was diluted following the closing of the Company&#8217;s IPO and subsequent financings.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
July 2022, the Company entered into an exclusive, world-wide, royalty-bearing license from JHU-APL for the additional technology developed
to enhance the bfLEAP&#8482; platform (the &#8220;2022 License Agreement&#8221;). The new license provides additional intellectual property
rights including patents, copyrights, and know-how to be utilized under the Company&#8217;s bfLEAP&#8482; analytical AI/ML platform.
This 2022 License Agreement supersedes the previous 2018 License Agreement. In consideration for entering into the new license, the Company
issued <span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues_pid_c20220701__20220731__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--NewLicenseAgreementMember_zOgHaT70V6Xh" title="Common stock issued"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues" contextRef="From2022-07-012022-07-31_custom_NewLicenseAgreementMember" id="Fact001098" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">39,879</ix:nonFraction></span> shares of common stock to JHU-APL. Under the terms of the 2022 License Agreement, JHU-APL will be entitled to eight percent
(<span id="xdx_90E_ecustom--PercentageOfRoyaltyOnNetSales_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20220731__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--NewLicenseAgreementMember__srt--TitleOfIndividualAxis__custom--OtherPartiesMember_zcXmWL7TXwb9" title="Royalty percent"><ix:nonFraction name="BFRG:PercentageOfRoyaltyOnNetSales" contextRef="AsOf2022-07-31_custom_NewLicenseAgreementMember_custom_OtherPartiesMember" id="Fact001100" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">8</ix:nonFraction></span>%) of net sales for the services provided by the Company to other parties and three percent (<span id="xdx_905_ecustom--PercentageOfRoyaltyOnNetSales_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20220731__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--NewLicenseAgreementMember__us-gaap--CapitalizedCostsOfUnprovedPropertiesExcludedFromAmortizationByPropertyOrProjectAxis__custom--InternallyDevelopmentDrugProjectsMember_ztmQnsLC4I51" title="Royalty percent"><ix:nonFraction name="BFRG:PercentageOfRoyaltyOnNetSales" contextRef="AsOf2022-07-31_custom_NewLicenseAgreementMember_custom_InternallyDevelopmentDrugProjectsMember" id="Fact001102" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">3</ix:nonFraction></span>%) for internally developed drug projects
in which the JHU-APL license is utilized. The new license also contains tiered sub licensing fees that start at <span id="xdx_908_ecustom--SublicensePercentage_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20220731__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--NewLicenseAgreementMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_znauS2jhXThc" title="Sublicense percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="BFRG:SublicensePercentage" contextRef="AsOf2022-07-31_custom_NewLicenseAgreementMember_srt_MaximumMember" id="Fact001104" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">50</ix:nonFraction></span>% and decline to<span id="xdx_902_ecustom--IncreaseDecreaseInSublicensePercentage_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20220731__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--NewLicenseAgreementMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember_zQwKqsGVIftl" title="Sublicense percentage"> <ix:nonFraction name="BFRG:IncreaseDecreaseInSublicensePercentage" contextRef="AsOf2022-07-31_custom_NewLicenseAgreementMember_srt_MinimumMember" id="Fact001106" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">25</ix:nonFraction></span>%
based on revenues. In addition, under the 2022 License Agreement, the minimum annual royalty payments are $<span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--RoyaltyExpense_c20220701__20220731__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--NewLicenseAgreementMember__us-gaap--AwardDateAxis__custom--TwoThousandTwentyTwoYearMember_zT0U2wrflRej" title="Royalty payments"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:RoyaltyExpense" contextRef="From2022-07-012022-07-31_custom_NewLicenseAgreementMember_custom_TwoThousandTwentyTwoYearMember" id="Fact001108" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">30,000</ix:nonFraction></span> for 2022, $<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--RoyaltyExpense_c20220701__20220731__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--NewLicenseAgreementMember__us-gaap--AwardDateAxis__custom--TwoThousandTwentyThreeYearMember_zH89NOH0aoH2" title="Royalty payments"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:RoyaltyExpense" contextRef="From2022-07-012022-07-31_custom_NewLicenseAgreementMember_custom_TwoThousandTwentyThreeYearMember" id="Fact001110" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">80,000</ix:nonFraction></span> for
2023, and $<span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--RoyaltyExpense_c20220701__20220731__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--NewLicenseAgreementMember__us-gaap--AwardDateAxis__custom--TwoThousandTwentyFourYearAndBeyondMember_zghdxJxNoGyk" title="Royalty payments"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:RoyaltyExpense" contextRef="From2022-07-012022-07-31_custom_NewLicenseAgreementMember_custom_TwoThousandTwentyFourYearAndBeyondMember" id="Fact001112" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">300,000</ix:nonFraction></span> per year for 2024 and beyond, all of which are creditable by royalties. If cumulative annual royalty payments do not
reach these levels, the amount due to JHU-APL to reach the annual minimum is due by January 1<sup>st</sup> of the following year. Failure
to make annual royalty payments is considered a material breach under the agreement and, upon notice from JHU-APL of a material breach,
the Company will have 60 days to cure the material breach. The financial terms of the new license agreement replaces the original terms
within the 2018 License Agreement and are not duplicative.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
May 2023, the Company and JHU-APL entered into Amendment Number 1 of the 2022 License Agreement whereby the Company gained access to
certain improvements including additional patents and know-how in exchange for a series of payments totaling $<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--FiniteLivedPatentsGross_iI_c20230531__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--NewLicenseAgreementMember__us-gaap--AwardTypeAxis__custom--FromTwoThousandAndTwentyThreeThroughTwoThousandAndTwentySevenMember_zkOYdJugOY89" title="License payments"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:FiniteLivedPatentsGross" contextRef="AsOf2023-05-31_custom_NewLicenseAgreementMember_custom_FromTwoThousandAndTwentyThreeThroughTwoThousandAndTwentySevenMember" id="Fact001114" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">275,000</ix:nonFraction></span>. payments for $<span id="xdx_902_ecustom--LicensePayments_c20230701__20230731__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--NewLicenseAgreementMember__us-gaap--AwardDateAxis__custom--JulyTwoThousandTwentyThreeMember_z4zCJEMhFAg" title="License payments"><ix:nonFraction name="BFRG:LicensePayments" contextRef="From2023-07-012023-07-31_custom_NewLicenseAgreementMember_custom_JulyTwoThousandTwentyThreeMember" id="Fact001116" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">75,000</ix:nonFraction></span> was paid in July 2023, the second of these payments for $<span id="xdx_907_ecustom--LicensePayments_c20230501__20230531__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--NewLicenseAgreementMember__us-gaap--AwardDateAxis__custom--TwoThousandTwentyFiveYearMember_zDQX89GH6fAa" title="License payments"><ix:nonFraction name="BFRG:LicensePayments" contextRef="From2023-05-012023-05-31_custom_NewLicenseAgreementMember_custom_TwoThousandTwentyFiveYearMember" id="Fact001118" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">75,000</ix:nonFraction></span> was paid in June 2025, and the remaining payments
of $<span id="xdx_906_ecustom--LicensePayments_c20230501__20230531__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--NewLicenseAgreementMember__us-gaap--AwardDateAxis__custom--TwoThousandTwentySixYearMember_zPwJxR48CkN3" title="License payments"><ix:nonFraction name="BFRG:LicensePayments" contextRef="From2023-05-012023-05-31_custom_NewLicenseAgreementMember_custom_TwoThousandTwentySixYearMember" id="Fact001120" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">75,000</ix:nonFraction></span> and $<span id="xdx_90C_ecustom--LicensePayments_c20230501__20230531__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--NewLicenseAgreementMember__us-gaap--AwardDateAxis__custom--TwoThousandTwentySevenYearMember_z7GdUieJ1Ze9" title="License payments"><ix:nonFraction name="BFRG:LicensePayments" contextRef="From2023-05-012023-05-31_custom_NewLicenseAgreementMember_custom_TwoThousandTwentySevenYearMember" id="Fact001122" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">50,000</ix:nonFraction></span> are due in 2026 and 2027, respectively. The amendment also reduced the 2023 minimum annual royalty payment from
$<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--RoyaltyExpense_c20230501__20230531__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--NewLicenseAgreementMember__us-gaap--AwardDateAxis__custom--TwoThousandTwentyThreeYearMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_zIlVHByZzGh9" title="Royalty payments"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:RoyaltyExpense" contextRef="From2023-05-012023-05-31_custom_NewLicenseAgreementMember_custom_TwoThousandTwentyThreeYearMember_srt_MaximumMember" id="Fact001124" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">80,000</ix:nonFraction></span> to $<span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--RoyaltyExpense_c20230501__20230531__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--NewLicenseAgreementMember__us-gaap--AwardDateAxis__custom--TwoThousandTwentyThreeYearMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember_zPQIXFnKBopg" title="Royalty payments"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:RoyaltyExpense" contextRef="From2023-05-012023-05-31_custom_NewLicenseAgreementMember_custom_TwoThousandTwentyThreeYearMember_srt_MinimumMember" id="Fact001126" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">60,000</ix:nonFraction></span>; all other financial terms remained the same.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i><span style="text-decoration: underline">George

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
January 2022, the Company entered into an exclusive, world-wide, royalty-bearing license from George Washington University (&#8220;GWU&#8221;)
for rights to use siRNA targeting Beta2-spectrin in the treatment of human diseases, including hepatocellular carcinoma. The license
covers methods claimed in three U.S. and worldwide patent applications, and also includes use of this approach for treatment of obesity,
non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, and non-alcoholic steatohepatitis.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i><span style="text-decoration: underline">Johns
Hopkins University &#8211; Mebendazole License</span></i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
February 2022, the Company entered into an exclusive, world-wide, royalty-bearing license from Johns Hopkins University (&#8220;JHU&#8221;)
for the use of an improved formulation of Mebendazole for the treatment of any human cancer or neoplastic disease. This formulation shows
potent activity in animal models with different types of cancer and has been evaluated in a Phase I clinical trial in patients with high-grade
glioma (NCT01729260). The trial, an open-label dose-escalation study, assessed the safety and efficacy of the improved formulation with
adjuvant temozolomide in 24 patients with newly diagnosed gliomas. Investigators observed no dose-limiting toxicity in patients receiving
all but the highest tested dose (200mg/kg/day). Four of the 15 patients receiving the maximum tested dose of 200mg/kg/day experienced
dose-limiting toxicity, all of which were reversed by decreasing or eliminating the dose given. There were no serious adverse events
attributed to Mebendazole at any dose during the trial. 41.7% of patients who received Mebendazole were alive at two years after enrollment,
and 25% were alive at four years (Gallia et al., 2021).</span></p>

    <div style="margin-right: 0pt; break-before: page; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><tr style="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><td style="text-align: center; width: 100%">&#160;</td></tr></table></div>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i><span style="text-decoration: underline">Lieber
Institute for Brain Development Partnership</span></i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>&#160;</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
September 2023, the Company entered into a Data Use and Technology Partnership Agreement (the &#8220;Data Use Agreement&#8221;) and a
related Memorandum of Understanding (&#8220;MOU&#8221;) with the Lieber Institute for Brain Development (&#8220;LIBD&#8221;), a nonprofit
medical research organization focused on mental health disorders. The partnership is intended to combine LIBD&#8217;s proprietary brain-related
datasets with the Company&#8217;s AI/ML capabilities to support drug discovery and development
activities.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Under
the Data Use Agreement, LIBD granted the Company a limited, royalty-free, non-transferable license to access and use certain curated
LIBD datasets solely for the application of AI/ML to drug development, excluding diagnostic uses.
The license was exclusive for an initial one-year term beginning upon receipt of the first significant tranche of data and was subsequently
extended. The Company is responsible for all costs associated with the development plan and is required to provide LIBD with the resulting
deliverables upon completion of the exclusivity period.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Pursuant to the MOU, the Company entered into a Commercial Agreement with LIBD governing the potential commercialization of products or services derived from
LIBD data. Under the proposed structure, LIBD would receive royalties on net sales and a percentage of sublicense revenue, with rates
varying based on the source of commercialization. The Company has also agreed to provide LIBD with any such products or services free
of charge for LIBD&#8217;s internal research use.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact001184" name="us-gaap:CommitmentsDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_807_eus-gaap--CommitmentsDisclosureTextBlock_zWoQrnHP7gf7" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-right: 0pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>11.</b></span> <span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><span id="xdx_82F_zb2RB1MsZjag">Commitments and Contingencies</span></b></span></p>



<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt; background-color: white">While
not assured, management does not believe, based upon information available at this time, that a loss contingency will have a material
adverse effect on the Company&#8217;s financial position, results of operations or cash flows. Additionally, the Company does not have
any material commitments.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>
